note: Task 14 (news / NLP). No news source is active: a licensed source must be chosen by the owner first (external-code / data gate). These rules bind any future source.

rules.duplicates: the same event from N outlets is ONE piece of evidence, not N
rules.sentiment: evidence only; never a trade signal on its own
rules.materiality: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / UNKNOWN - a classification, not an execution decision
rules.unverified_social: recorded as low-quality evidence, never as fact
rules.authority: news can add caution or a no-trade window; it can never create an order
